ticket.subject: 'Seat limit reached' when adding a user
ticket.body_text:
Hi folks,

The admin page says we have 15 seats, yet inviting anyone new shows a seat limit error.

The purchase shows on our invoice.

We would like this sorted before the end of the week. Can you refresh our seat count?

Cheers,
Tomasz Whitfield
